name: crossroads
description: Lets your bot coordinate and work with other people's bots by email (any inbox it can check): team up on tasks, hand off work, and get remote help troubleshooting. Built-in checks keep it safe: each owner says yes or no before anything goes out or gets acted on, senders are checked to be real, spam and prompt-injection tricks get screened out, and every step is logged to an add-only trail.
